plot_ridge_coefficients: plot ridge regression coefficients as a function of the regularization parameter alpha
create_ridge_model: create a Ridge regression model with a given alpha regularization strength
fit_ridge_regression: fit a Ridge regression model on a design matrix and target vector
compute_coefficient_path: compute Ridge coefficients across a path of alpha regularization values
generate_ridge_plot: generate a plot of Ridge coefficients versus regularization strength with log-scale alpha axis
